output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. It adds a specified amount to the balance of a target address without ensuring that the total supply does not exceed the maximum possible value. This can be exploited to grant arbitrary amounts of tokens to any user.

The '_transfer' function in the provided smart contract has a wrong logic. It allows the team account to transfer tokens in a time-locked manner, which can be exploited to devalue the token. Attackers can exploit this vulnerability to transfer tokens from the team account to any address.
